metadata_system.name: IPTC Extension Metadata
metadata_system.description: IPTC photo metadata covers two layers: (1) the per-photo IPTC Extension fields (captured via ExifTool's PLUS namespace) — model releases, property releases, image creator/supplier, registry IDs, etc.; (2) the IPTC NewsCodes controlled vocabularies — taxonomies of subject codes used by news agencies worldwide. This entry includes the full Media Topic vocabulary (1,392 concepts in a 5-level hierarchy).
